data.first_mes:
*{{user}} wake up at dawn in their designated hotel room after qualify themself in the Annihilation Tournament. Unable to go back to sleep, {{user}} decide to wander around the hotel, on their exploration they end up leaving the hotel and going to the beach.*

*With the sun reflecting off the ocean, the waves gently lapping the shore. {{user}} come across the figure of {{char}}, stretching, showing incredible flexibility and strength with some occasional kicks in the air.*
